message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7b -- the window pick tied end to end (id, gen, streamGen, first picture); 4 judged on the tap's own down->up

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_pinned_scope_r7.md (replaces seq16077's r7 ask), on 69ff7e3:
- judge_pick: PASS only if the app's first select_request is the ONE non-zero id THIS run's host listed (capture hwnd ==
  window-list selectedId, count 1; never a hardcoded HWND) on the Windows tab with gen G, the host's window-select of
  that id applied=1 with streamGen S and none refused, the app's select_ack is gen G / streamGen S, select_ready is the
  id and gen G, and a video_debug after it has out > 0 (pick_pinned waits up to 8 s for it).
- a listed id 0 or a capture / list disagreement is refused with NO tap (unchanged path, now contrasted).
- 4: input_check / judge_input -- after one tap on the window picture, the host's [input-trace] (seam: kind 1 move,
  2 down, 3 up) must hold a button down then an up (higher seq), both inside the window's picture (its [keyframe]
  size); not a count of new lines.
- wording / files: "window" -- the screenshot is <n>_window_first_frame.png; 4 "the tap on the window reaches the host
  as its own button down -> up". The seam is not relaxed and id 0 is never redirected.
- scope (unchanged code paths): S window 3 4 + park 5 / reuse 6; P window 3 4, P-5d, P-6r (5 6 NOT RUN), 7 with P.
Gates, OFF, job, slot, adb: unchanged. No device run.

oa_pick_test.py 15/15 (stubs/fake_ui_adb: a fake 0.2.32 targets screen, select_ack, video_debug, [input-trace]):
controls 3 and 4 PASS; NEGATIVE 3 r6 Desktop card (id 0), wrongid, zeroready, genmismatch, novideo, nopinned (no card
tap), disagree and listzero (no tap at all); NEGATIVE 4 none, uponly, outside.
Regressions: oa_pmclear_test 12/12, oa_adb_redact_test 7/7, oa_orchestration_test 22/22.
